scope: Add Datacenter / A-series marketplace search and preserve rental compatibility/lifecycle checks
changes: Family filter and All GPUs search include compatible A-series offers
Non-RTX datacenter names are no longer discarded by the backend
GPU probe handles Vast A100 PCIe/SXM4 names versus nvidia-smi naming while checking model, interconnect and reported memory class
Price sorting, selected storage allocation, host verification and exact-ask preflight remain in the existing rental path
Filters wrap on narrow layouts; datacenter speed is explicitly unbenchmarked

validation.browserUi: Selected Datacenter / A-series in Safari; live A40, A100 PCIe/SXM4 and A800 offers and compatibility note visible in the accessibility tree; family filter layout visually inspected
validation.gpuInference: Not benchmarked on A-series hardware by this change

limitations: Cards below the existing reported memory or CUDA/driver requirements are excluded even if their family is listed
Hardware compatibility is not a speed or visual-quality benchmark
No changes to model weights, sampling settings or character reference conditioning
